patch_list: Accent color
Replaces the red of Apple Music (buttons, links, the selected tab, progress) with another color. Blue matches the liquid tab bar.
Liquid Glass

Liquid Glass on the floating tab bar and the mini player: clear glass with refracted edges, vibrancy and a specular rim, and the liquid tab bar of Backdrop by Kyant, with a drop of glass on the active tab. Refraction requires Android 13, t…
Liquid Glass icon
Replaces the app icon with the LiquidMusic icon: a drop of glass over the colors. It also has a themed icon for Android 13+.

sources.label: Dutch App
sources.author: Dutch App
patch_list: Allow custom Android Auto hosts

Lets Apple Music's car media browser accept a third-party Android Auto host such as DriveDeck or Gearslip and use its Android Auto root. Apple Music's account, catalogue and playback services are unchanged.

sources.label: Custom patches by Nich87 for use with Morphe.
sources.author: Nich87
patch_list: Library import, export and downloads
Adds JSON library and playlist backups, additive import, and a native download action for the entire library.
Liquid Glass bottom bar
Adds live refractive glass to Apple Music's mini-player and bottom tabs, with whole-bar touch feedback, drag parallax and an animated selection lens. Refraction requires Android 13 or newer.
Repair Japanese library metadata
Finds romanized library metadata and repairs selected songs using Japanese catalog data, preserving library entries and syncing changes to the account.

sources.label: Apple Music
sources.author: Apple Music
patch_list: DiLink: manifest
Lowers minSdkVersion from 30 to 29 (Android 10) and removes the portrait lock of MLIChromeTabActivity.
DiLink: support
Unlocks landscape rotation, lowers the API floor to Android 10 (API 29), backports the API 30 java/androidx/accessibility calls and bypasses Play Integrity.
DiLink: TLS trust

Trusts the bundled Apple Root CA (res/raw/apple_ca) for gsd.apple.com only, inside the APK, so the Apple sign-in page loads on a head unit whose system CA store lacks that root. Nothing is installed on the device.
DiLink: web assets
Embeds Chrome 74-compatible copies of the Apple sign-in JavaScript assets so the sign-in page can run on the DiLink WebView, without a PC at runtime.
TV: D-pad focus
Adds a visible focus highlight to the Listen Now cards, the Search rows and the player, and reserves room for the mini player around the content viewport.
TV: manifest
Adds a leanback launcher entry point and banner to MainActivity and declares leanback/touchscreen as not required.
TV: player expand focus
Moves the D-pad focus into the Now Playing controls when the player sheet expands, because the sheet container itself is not focusable.
